title: Weather kind
description: One weather kind, per docs/adr/0016-weather-kinds-and-seasons.md and docs/16-weather.md's content shape: a JSON entry declaring its duration range, its seasonal draw weights and what it moves. The kind's name is the file's stem (weather/<kind>.json) and the id is weather.<kind>; SimWeather reads an entry by that path. Every modifier is optional with an identity default, so weather.clear is an entry with a range and weights and nothing else. NOTE: the content validator is shallow -- it checks these top-level types and rejects unexpected top-level keys, and does not recurse into the range, weight and lightning objects; check_m2_weather.gd's CONTENT lane holds the inner shape (min < max, weights non-negative, every season drawable, the multipliers inside their bands).

id.description: Stable namespaced id, weather.<kind>. Permanent once shipped.

durationTicks.description: Ticks one span of this kind lasts, drawn uniformly in [min, max] on the `weather` stream. 12000 ticks to the in-game hour. For weather.clear this is the gap between spells.

weights.description: Relative draw weight per season (climate.temperate's calendar). Zero means never in that season. Read when a clear span ends: the next kind is rolled among the non-clear kinds by the current season's weights.

wets.description: Whether a body outdoors gets wet under it (docs/adr/0015's wetness, climate.temperate's timings). Rain and storm.

scentHalfLifeMul.description: What this kind multiplies the scent half-life by (calibration.attention's scentHalfLifeMinutes). Expressed as a half-life factor and not a per-step one on purpose: docs/23's Weather record has the per-step first cut that wiped a colony. 1 (the default) is no change.

noiseHalfLifeMul.description: What this kind multiplies the noise half-life by (noiseHalfLifeSeconds) -- docs/16's storm masking. Same half-life convention. 1 is no change.

tempShift.description: Bands the temperature ladder shifts under this sky: negative toward cold (applies day and night, indoors too, cancelled by a lit fire), positive toward hot (applies by day, outdoors, cancelled by nothing). needs._tick_temperature reads it after the night/fire/roof base and before wet and the wrap.

survivorMoveMul.description: A global move_speed multiplier on every living body while this kind runs, applied through the modifier store under source `weather`. Snow does not use it: its slowing comes off the cover (climate.snowCoverMoveMul).

zombieMoveMul.description: What a shambler's speed is multiplied by (SimShambler._speed_of, the one read). docs/16's cold: 'the only state that weakens them directly'.

spoilageMul.description: What the pantry's spoilage rate is multiplied by. Above one for heat, below for cold.

thirstMul.description: What the thirst drain is multiplied by. Heat.

corpseScentMul.description: What a corpse's scent emission is multiplied by. Heat: docs/16's 'corpse rot accelerates'.

outdoorWork.description: Whether a job on an outdoor tile can start or continue. false for storm. Guard is watch, not work, and is exempt.

windMul.description: What the climate's wind strength is multiplied by under this kind before it reaches the attention field. Storm doubles it.

lightning.description: Storm only: strikes land on an open outdoor tile every intervalTicks (drawn on the weather stream) as a noise.emitted of `noise` and a weather.lightning event. The magnitude must not equal 180, 120 or 4 -- presentation/sfx.gd dispatches one-shots by exact magnitude.

coverPerTick.description: Snow only: how much ground cover (0..1) one tick of this kind lays. climate.temperate's meltPerTick takes it away when it is not falling.
